Traveling With Baby

Pack smart

Use packing cubes labeled for feeding, diapering, and sleep. Keep a mini kit in your carry-on for delays.

Gear MVPs

  • Travel stroller with shoulder strap
  • Portable blackout shades
  • Wearable sound machine
